text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My times... aren't improving at all...
How can this be...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Clan has its own ways.
We have strictly adhered to them and flourished thus far, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a bouquet...?
Did you put together this lovely arrangement yourself?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Chairwoman asked me to pick them out.
She mentioned wanting something 'as gorgeous as possible,' so I arranged a bouquet fit for the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm, wait... Those roses are...? They are in magnificent bloom. Though I have never seen such a variety before.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Actually, this one—is a new variety.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Many garden roses... are foreign varieties.
If they do not adapt to this country's soil—
they cannot bloom properly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A new breed that adapts well will take firm root—
and bloom taking in the full strength of the earth...
or so the breeder told me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Unless one adapts to this soil... one cannot truly bloom, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. Perhaps we, too... have arrived
at such a juncture.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I am glad you came. Today, I wish to seek your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course, I don't mind at all, but why me, of all people~?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though born overseas, she took root in this country,
blooming serenely as an ideal Yamato Nadeshiko. And in her stride—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I foresee that the key to our clan's awakening lies within.
—Now, let us proceed.

text_block_list.name: Rose & Grass
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah—!!
Haaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Do not fear... change. Countless years have passed
since my ancestors arrived in this country from France...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The Rose clan must evolve.
It will be well—so long as I never lose my pride as a true scion of our line.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, I broke through! The wall I couldn't seem to overcome no matter what—and by a wide margin!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the rose has... spread its roots far and wide.
Let us show them from here—the second blooming.
